 The Police-Inspector of Basavanagudi Women South P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused No.1 to 3 for the offences punishable U/s.498A,323, 504,506 r/w/s 34 of IPC. & Sec.3, 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt. Janani K.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused No.1 married CW-1 on 23-08- 2023.

At the time of marriage, the accused No.1 to 3 have demanded and taken gold ornaments weighing 40 grams, suit,
Royal Enfield Bike, Watch to the accused No.1 as dowry.
The accused have demanded to put 130 grams of gold ornaments to  3  C.C.No.28919/2024 CW-1, 300 grams of Silver and Sarees to CW-1 as dowry from complainant and her family.

The accused No.1 to 3 after marriage,
have subjected CW-1 to mental and physical cruelty by quarreling with CW-1 without any reason, making CW-1 to do all house hold chores, did not provide her with proper food, did not provide her medical treatment when she was ill and pledged all the jewellary of CW-1 and when CW-1 asked the accused to return the ornaments to her, the accused No.2 and 3 used to instigate accused No.1 and he would assault and abuse CW-1, the accused No.1 used to show Smt Janani K vs Vignesh M on 2 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10094834/
2 explicit pictures to CW-1 and harass her to perform the same sexual acts with him.

sentences.text: The accused No.1 to 3 used to suspect her character, assault her, abuse her in filthy language, when CW-1 used to cry due to pain of assault, the accused No.1 to 3 told her if she cries loudly they would kill her and throw her body in the river and on 06-12-2023 the accused have quarreled with CW-1 to get additional dowry, assaulted CW-1 with hands, legs and belt causing injuries to her and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.49/2024 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
After completion of the investigation, the P.I. Basavanagudi Women south P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused person caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  abused, assaulted and threatened her and thereby  accused have committed the offences punishable  U/s.498A,323, 504,506 r/w/s 34 of IPC. & Sec.3, 4 of  the Dowry Prohibition Act...?
 2) what order?
 8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:-
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex. P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt.Janani.

She in her Smt Janani K vs Vignesh M on 2 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10094834/
4 examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused  6  C.C.No.28919/2024 No.1 was performed on 23-08-2023 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never abused, assaulted and threatened to kill her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.

sentences.text: There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the  7  C.C.No.28919/2024 material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.

As such other charge Smt Janani K vs Vignesh M on 2 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10094834/
5 sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.

sentences.text:
In view of the material witness, turning hostile,
and in the absence of evidence of material witness, the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER

In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1 to 3 are acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A,323, 504,506 r/w/s 34 of IPC. & Sec.3, 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 to 3 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.

(Dictated to the Stenographer directly on the computer and print out taken by her is verified,
corrected & then pronounced by me in the Open Court dated this the 02-02-2026).
(SYED ARFATH IBRAHIM M.) XXXVII ACJM., BENGALURU.
